$Comment: The quick contract on the two-hour board: a short run of boards off the Sawmill. STATION_OUTPUT counts every cut of every species the mill hands over ('Wood_' on PREFIX, qualified to the Sawmill, so lumber from a hand bench does not count) and carries the shared mill_lumber TextKey, since the kind's default line names a single item. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Bihourly board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature gate in Requires is for a server where stations have been switched off: a board draws its slots without reading a contract's Requires, so the gate refuses at Accept rather than keeping the contract off the board.
